rules: Use the frozen v2 MADE and frequency distribution. No generator retraining and no new source-bank collection.
Change only conditional decoding temperature. T=1 reproduces the original sampler, T=0 is greedy decoding.
Choose temperature by mean best-of-eight source-query BCE on four source patterns. No target or analytic index labels enter calibration.
Among temperatures within 0.0001 of the minimum calibration query BCE, choose the highest to preserve randomness when it does not hurt source performance.
Apply the same temperature grid, budget and selection rule to independent frequencies.
Freeze temperature choices before fitting target patterns. Use the same target partitions and numerical initializations as v2 for a paired developmental comparison.
Final methods: AR T1/calibrated/greedy, frequencies T1/calibrated/greedy, inferred consensus, dense Adam and SGD.
Use no top-k support or tying-capacity constraint in decoding. The inherited bank preprocessing assumptions remain unchanged.
Evaluate 8192 proposal samples only after final target choices are frozen; never use exact-indexator metrics for selection.
Pattern has a single shared indexator. Greedy frequency success would limit evidence for conditional dependencies or combinatorial generalization.
This is debugging on a previously viewed benchmark, not an independent confirmatory evaluation. Do not write or run tests.
